V4_forkSimulation.note: On an anvil fork of testnet with time advanced 7,300 s, the halt recorded in 0xe72bb66e354e36668fadba853918038cfe9583422a1cccb7de8966a4ab514fa9 read back as NORMAL (haltedUntil 0) without any resume or renew. The hook then reported mode HALTED with reason bits 352 (REPORT_INVALID_OR_STALE, CALENDAR_CONFLICT, CALENDAR_MISSING): the testnet calendar interval had ended and no keeper or reports run there, so a swap at the normal fee is not shown. This is a simulation on a fork, not the live check; the live V4 check stays pending until the halt lapses on the real chain.
